text:
beth: Quick heads-up — new joiner hit a SyntaxError running the Node quickstart. Our README uses top-level await and an old import. They were on Node 16 and got 'Unexpected token'.

beth: Current snippet:
```js
import Redwood from 'redwood';
const client = new Redwood();
const res = await client.generate({ input: 'hi' });
console.log(res.output);
```

omar: Yep. Two issues: (1) top-level await needs Node 18+ unless you use --experimental flag; (2) SDK renamed exports in 2.x so docs are out of sync.

beth: Proposed tiny changes: replace with an async IIFE example, update import to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`, and add an engines note. Also add a short FAQ entry "SyntaxError when running quickstart".

omar: Also suggest we add a smoke check to docs CI: run the Node quickstart on matrix node-version: [16,18,20] and fail if the snippet claims to support a version but actually errors.

ci-bot: Draft job created: docs/snippet-smoke-node -> strategy.matrix.node-version [16,18,20]. Currently a proposal (not merged).

docs-bot: Filed DOCS-513: "Sync Node quickstart with SDK 2.x + add snippet smoke tests" and linked draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/330.

beth: I'll open the PR that swaps to async IIFE and updates imports; omar can add the CI change in a follow-up.

omar: I'll also update samples/quickstart so both repos match. We'll add a tiny smoke test in samples that runs `node quickstart.js` on node 18.

beth: Thanks — small change but will stop a lot of first-day support DMs. :raised_hands:
